prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in San Francisco?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single “best” digital marketing agency in San Francisco — the right agency depends on your goals, budget, industry, and the channels you need (SEO, paid media, social, creative/product design, analytics, etc.). That said, a few highly regarded agencies with San Francisco presence are:

- AKQA — strong in digital product, experience design and creative technology for big brands.  
- R/GA — integrated brand, tech and product work; good for complex digital transformation projects.  
- Huge — large, full-service digital agency focused on customer experience and digital strategy.  
- Razorfish — global digital marketing and media capabilities, good for media + creative at scale.  
- Fantasy — boutique UX/UI and product design studio (good if you need cutting‑edge design).

How to choose the “best” for you
- Match services to goals (lead gen vs brand vs product/UX).  
- Look for industry experience and relevant case studies.  
- Check measurable results (ROI, KPIs, retention).  
- Evaluate team size/culture and whether you want an enterprise or boutique partner.  
- Confirm tools/tech stack and reporting cadence.  
- Read reviews on Clutch, G2, and look at award shows (Webby, Cannes, Effies).

If you tell me: 1) your primary goals (e.g., sales, leads, brand awareness), 2) monthly marketing budget, and 3) the channels you care about (SEO, PPC, social, design, product), I’ll shortlist 3–5 San Francisco agencies (with pros/cons) that fit your needs. Which of those details can you share?
